cn: 随着智能手机的普及，越来越多的人习惯用手机阅读新闻。
ref: With the popularity of smartphones, more and more people are used to reading news on their phones.
tips: with the popularity of …（随着…的普及）
be used to doing（习惯做某事）

cn: 保持健康的最好方式是每天坚持适量运动。
ref: The best way to keep healthy is to take proper exercise every day.
tips: the best way to …（…的最好方式）
